description: A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft Java 1.21.x that improves gameplay under high latency. It reduces visual desync, optimizes explosion particles, stabilizes inventory and food interactions, and enhances Crystal PvP responsiveness without changing server-side game logic.

mods.name: Akinoko's Crystal Optimizer
mods.description: Client-side QoL mod: stabilizes offhand/food/crystal interactions under lag, reduces duplicate inputs, and lightens explosion/particle rendering. Does NOT change server-side hit registration or automate combat.

releases.notes:
## Akinoko Crystal Optimizer v1.0.0

Initial public release of Akinoko Crystal Optimizer.

### Features

- Totem visual synchronization improvements
- Food interaction stabilization under high latency
- End crystal placement optimization
- Inventory synchronization improvements
- Redundant input and packet suppression
- Ping and synchronization status display
- Explosion and particle effect optimization
- Configurable client-side performance settings
- English and Japanese localization

### Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 21
- Mod Menu recommended

### Notes

This is a client-side QoL and performance optimization mod.  
It does not modify or bypass server-side game logic.

Always check the rules of the server before using this mod.
